title: Polynomial circuit size as a union of advice classes
statement: The set of Boolean languages having a family of fan-in-two circuits of size at most $a(n+1)^k$ for some natural numbers $a,k$ equals the union, over natural numbers $c,d$, of the classes decidable by a polynomial-time Turing machine with advice strings of length exactly $n^d$ on inputs of length $n$.
